methods.mode1: Stop Wi-Fi at 240, confirm STA_STOP, change PLL, start/connect at260
methods.mode2: Stop at240, then deinit/init/configure/start/connect at260; Wi-Fi configuration RAM-only
methods.mode3: Mode1 plus doubled SPI0/SPI1 flash and SPI0 PSRAM dividers; core160 nominal, divider2 becomes4; intended memory clock ~43.3MHz atPLL520
methods.control: Same full deinit/init flow at240, then 12 seconds ac-ootb.it from180s with current Full/Bright Plate reverb

measurement.cpu: CCOUNT against XTAL SYSTIMER (1 ms) before/after Wi-Fi initialization and once per second; not inferred from ROM cached MHz
measurement.apb: GPTimer created at stock from APB80 with 1MHz requested resolution (prescaler80); hardware raw counter delta measured against XTAL SYSTIMER (2 ms); 80,000,000 -> 86,669,995 -> 80,000,000 Hz in mode3
measurement.audio: I2S uses XTAL in all temporary builds; failed260 cases stay stopped; only successful240 control plays the song
measurement.recovery: RTC slow-clock watchdog40s plus explicit PLL480/CPU240 restoration and deliberate reboot after each experiment; code never overclocks at boot

interpretation.result: None of three 260MHz strategies connected, obtained IP, or served HTTP/WS at the requested high clock. CPU stayed genuinely260MHz, all Wi-Fi API calls succeeded, and 64KiB RAM canaries passed.
interpretation.driverEvents: All high-clock cases report disconnect reason201 (NO_AP_FOUND), and an explicitly requested active scan completes with zero APs. Initial reason8 and later reason36 belong to deliberate stop/disconnect, not spontaneous unexplained failure.
interpretation.control: Full reinit at240 gets IP after3.441s and serves12 HTTP responses and11 WS diagnostics at the requested clock while playing12s; ping replies received. This validates credentials, station interface and the test setup.
interpretation.scope: Failures occur with the song stopped, without new sampled render overruns or DMA underruns. This is not just the web server stalling under dense music load. Lower memory clocks do not restore Wi-Fi.
interpretation.clockCoupling: Independent APB measurement confirms shared peripheral clock rose about8.3%; Espressif TRM clock structure routes APB to Wi-Fi. Strong support for shared-clock incompatibility with the customPLL method, not a separately proved internal PHY failure mechanism or proof that every possible method is impossible.
interpretation.noPersistentChange: Production sources and config restored exactly. Temporary endpoint, Wi-Fi ownership gate, GPTimer probe and disabled CPU guard removed. Samples/project compared after every reboot; transport restored.
interpretation.limits: Short board trials, no long soak, no RF spectrum/power/temperature measurement, no undocumented RF-register or voltage modification.
